init_BaseModule: create a BaseModule subclass with an init_cfg dict to control weight initialization
call_init_weights: call init_weights on a BaseModule instance to initialize all parameters and log init info
check_is_init: check the is_init property of a BaseModule to see if weights have been initialized
create_Sequential: create a Sequential module that wraps nn.Sequential with BaseModule initialization support
create_ModuleList: create a ModuleList that wraps nn.ModuleList with BaseModule initialization and init_cfg support
